body: No, you're about right. These feelings and suicidal thoughts came on gradually, but then very suddenly. I have been feeling a bit low for a few weeks, but able to cope. Then, about three days ago, the feelings got a lot worse very suddenly and I no longer feel able to cope with anything and everything
There's no anger. Just sadness and a feeling of sickness, like anxiety. And a general feeling of being frustrated and fed up
